activity.toggleSidebar: Show or hide the side bar
tool.label: Label
tool.hint.select: Drag a shape to move it · drag on the paper to select · right button: menu
tool.hint.box: Drag on the active plane to draw a volume · start on a roof to stack
tool.hint.cut: Drag over a volume to take a part of it away · the cut stays editable
tool.hint.arrow: Drag from start to end · height, curve and colour are in the properties
tool.hint.person: Click where the person stands (on the ground or on a roof)
tool.hint.label: Click the point the label refers to, then type the text
drawing.rotateLeft: Turn the view 90° to the left
drawing.rotateRight: Turn the view 90° to the right
object.label: Label
props.title: Properties
prop.zStacked: Sits on another volume, at {z} m
state.normalTip: The colour of the style or of its category
state.ghostTip: Dashed edges only (what was or will be)
series.hint: Copies side by side, like the three parallel bars of a layout.
cut.explain: A subtraction takes part of a volume away. It is kept as an object, so it can be moved and resized later.
cut.heightsHint: A high cut goes through the whole volume. A low one opens a passage on the ground floor.
arrow.colorHint: Choosing a category's colour puts the arrow in the sheet's legend.
person.hint: People are drawn at their real height (1.75 m), to give the scale.
label.editTip: Enter applies · Shift+Enter starts another line · Esc gives up
label.textHint: Shown in capitals. A new line starts a second line.
step.title: Title
step.textPlaceholder: Two or three lines that explain the step
step.highlight: Show what changed in the accent colour
step.highlightHint: New volumes, and volumes that changed or were cut since the previous step, take the accent colour.
step.highlightFirst: The first step has nothing before it: everything is new, so nothing is highlighted.
steps.addLong: New step (copy of the current one)
steps.hint: Each step starts as a copy of the current one. Change only what the step is about.
steps.lastOne: A project always has at least one step.
steps.removeText: The step “{title}” and everything drawn in it will be deleted. You can still undo right after.
categories.uses: Volumes and arrows that use it
categories.remove: Delete category (volumes and arrows keep their shape)
categories.empty: No categories yet. Uses such as stair core, circulation or theatre get a colour here and appear in the sheet's legend.
categories.hint: The sheet's legend lists only the categories in use.
project.notSaved: Not saved in a file yet. Your work is kept in a recovery copy anyway.
project.name: Project name
project.styleHint: The style changes colours and lines in the drawing, the sheet and the exports.
file.notAProject: this is not a LionAxon project
file.newerSchema: the file was made by a newer version of LionAxon
sheet.title: Title
sheet.subtitle: Subtitle
sheet.exportHint: PDF and SVG are vectors, the same as the screen. The SVG opens in Illustrator and Inkscape with one layer per step.
sheet.exportStepHint: Only the drawing of step {n}, without title or text, to use in another sheet.
welcome.example: This is the example that comes with LionAxon: five steps of a parti diagram. Change it freely, or start a new project (Ctrl+N).
welcome.recovered: The diagrams of the last session are back, with the changes that had not been saved.
about.title: About LionAxon
about.text: LionAxon makes parti diagrams and massing studies for architecture: simple volumes on a site, steps that tell how the design came about, and a sheet ready to print, from the same drawing.
about.credit: Created and conceived by Daniel Michelon De Carli.
about.team: LionAxon Team · a sibling of LionOrganizer, LionPhotos and LionFoundry
about.license: Free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0 or later.
about.privacy: No account, no telemetry. The app only uses the network when you check for a new version.
update.title: Versions
update.idle: Press “Check now” to look for a new version on GitHub.
update.error: Could not check. Check your connection and try again.
update.privacy: Checking reads one small file of the latest release on GitHub; updating downloads the installer from there. Both only when you click. Nothing about you or your projects is sent.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.rotate: Turn the selection 90° (Shift: 15°); while moving, Space turns it on the way
shortcuts.nudge: Move the selection by the grid (Shift: 0.1 m)
shortcuts.noSnap: Hold while dragging to leave the grid
shortcuts.escape: Back to select, clear the selection
tool.hint.terrain: Drag to draw a platform or a slope between two heights
level.activeHint: Reference plane new objects are drawn on
level.title: Reference planes
level.groundFixed: The ground plane cannot be removed
level.remove: Remove plane (what is on it goes to the ground plane, at the same height)
level.hint: Each object belongs to a plane. Change a plane's elevation and everything on it moves with it. The blue dot marks the plane new objects are drawn on.
site.thicknessHint: With a thickness, the site is drawn as a block of earth: pits and platforms below zero cut into it.
north.drawingTip: Flat on the ground, next to each drawing
north.hint: In plan the north arrow is always drawn next to the drawing (unless it is turned off).
state.ghostHint: A ghost can still be clicked on its dashed lines, or picked in the element list (nothing selected).
platform.explain: A plane of the ground at another height: above zero a plateau, below zero a pit cut into the site.
slope.explain: A sloped plane of the ground between two heights: an embankment, a ramp, a terrace edge. It goes up along its length (L).
elements.title: Elements
elements.label: Labels
close.title: Save the changes to “{name}”?
close.message: If you don't save, the changes are lost.
close.more: {n} more diagram(s) with unsaved changes after this one.
statusbar.themeMapTip: Cream paper, dark green and vermilion (from a city map poster)
statusbar.themeRiverfrontTip: Sea green, deep teal and blue (from a riverfront masterplan)
sheet.verticalTip: One step under the other, the text beside each drawing: an evolution sheet read from top to bottom
sheet.scaleAutoIs: The drawings come out at about 1:{n}.
sheet.scaleOverflow: At this scale the drawings are wider than the {paper}; {fit} or smaller fits.
sheet.pagesMany: The steps take {n} {paper} pages (the PDF has them all; SVG and PNG give one file per page).
sheet.scaleStacked: At this scale the text goes under each drawing; {fit} or smaller keeps it beside.
elev.facingTip.front: Seen from the front of the site (the bottom side of the plan)
elev.facingTip.right: Seen from the right side of the site
elev.facingTip.back: Seen from the back of the site
elev.facingTip.left: Seen from the left side of the site
elev.hint.select: Drag a level line to change its elevation · drag an object onto a line to anchor it
elev.hint.level: Click at the height of the new reference plane (half metres; Alt: free)
cut.shapeHint: Cones, pyramids and spheres are cut in thin slices: the hollow narrows in steps. They cut boxes, cylinders, platforms and the site; curved volumes (cone, pyramid, sphere) are not cut.
drawing.terrainMesh: See-through terrain: the grid follows platforms and slopes; a piece shows when the mouse is over it
explode.title: Exploded view
explode.hint: The reference planes move apart one gap each, and stacked volumes rise above the one below; dashed lines show where each piece belongs. The sheet shows the step exploded too.
orbit.preset.frontTip: From the front (the bottom side of the plan), level
orbit.preset.belowTip: From below, at the isometric angle
orbit.azTip: Azimuth: the direction the model is seen from, in degrees (0 = from the east, 90 = from the north)
orbit.elTip: Elevation: how high the eye is, in degrees (90 = from above, 0 = level, negative = from below)
orbit.useTip: The sheet shows this step from this angle
orbit.addTip: The step gets one more drawing, side by side, seen from this angle. It stays one step, with one caption.
orbit.resetTip: Back to the project's axonometric angle (the one of the Axonometric tab)
orbit.hint: Drag the paper to orbit · click a shape to select it, drag it to move it, pull its handles to resize it · middle or right button: pan, with Shift orbit (Sketch mode: the other way round) · the wheel zooms
orbit.projectAngle: On the sheet: the project's angle
orbit.remove: Take this angle out of the step
orbit.max: A step shows at most {n} angles side by side.
orbit.title: Angles on the sheet
orbit.summary0: The project's axonometric angle. In the 3D viewer you can turn the step all the way round and give it its own angle, or several side by side.
sheet.hint: The sheet as it will be exported · layout, paper and scale are on the left
shortcuts.panKeys: Space + drag · middle or right button
shortcuts.clipboard: Copy · cut · paste (also to another step or diagram)
shortcuts.typeSize: Type the size of the selected shape (width × depth × height)
shortcuts.cycle: The next object under the same spot (Shift: the one before); the others fade
shortcuts.editLabel: Double-click a label (or Enter with it selected): write its text on the drawing
shortcuts.contextMenu: Menu of the object (or of the paper)
edit.nothingToPaste: Nothing to paste yet: copy something first (Ctrl+C).
propagate.delete: Delete here and in the following steps
propagate.done: Applied to {n} step(s) after this one.
propagate.none: The following steps already have it like this.
propagate.hint: Each step is a copy: use this to carry what you changed here to the steps after it (the object is replaced where it exists, added where it does not).
align.title: Align
align.hint: In plan: X runs left to right, Y front to back. Distribute needs three or more objects. While you move a shape, pink guides show when it lines up with another.
zoom.title: Zoom
size.title: Size
orbit.editTip: Go to the Axonometric tab, where new shapes are drawn (Ctrl+1)
welcome.title: Welcome to LionAxon
welcome.guide: A parti diagram in four moves
welcome.again: This screen is in Help › Welcome to LionAxon.
welcome.g1: Draw volumes on the site (B). Drag the handles for size and height, or type the numbers.
welcome.g2: Subtract (S) to carve a notch or a passage; start on a roof to stack.
welcome.g3: Add a step: it starts as a copy. Change only what that step tells; what changed shows in the accent colour.
welcome.g4: Open the Sheet: every step at the same scale, ready as PDF, SVG or PNG.
categories.patternsHint: Each category also gets a hatch, on the drawings and in the legend: it reads in grey print and for colour-blind readers.
prop.name: Name

poly.hint: An outline of {n} corners, {w} × {d} m. Drag a corner to move it, the small mark in the middle of a side for a new corner; double-click a corner to take it out.
tool.hint.poly: Click each corner · click the first again, double-click or Enter to close · Esc cancels
tool.hint.dim: Drag from one point to the other · the offset is in the properties
tool.hint.site: Click each corner of the site
area.explain: A flat piece of the surroundings, drawn on the ground under the volumes.
dim.offset: Distance of the line from the points measured (negative: the other side)
dim.hint: The number is the distance between the two points; it follows them when they move.
roof.title: Roof
roof.hint: The roof sits on top of the walls; the ridge follows the longer side.
state.contextTip: A neighbour: neutral grey, never highlighted, out of the legend
state.contextHint: Context volumes show the surroundings: they stay grey whatever the step tells.
step.ghostPrev: Show what the previous step had
step.ghostPrevHint: Volumes taken away or changed since the previous step appear dashed, as they were.
step.opHint: On the sheet, a sign between the previous step and this one: + adds, − takes away, = results, → leads to.
site.drawHint: For a site that is not a rectangle: draw its outline corner by corner, in plan.
site.outlineHint: A site of {n} corners. Width and depth are those of its bounds.
underlay.title: Image underneath
underlay.width: Width of the image on the ground
underlay.sheet: Show it on the sheet too
underlay.hint: A site plan or an aerial photo under the drawing, to draw over it. Give it its real width in metres. The image is kept inside the project file.
underlay.failed: The image could not be opened. {error}
sun.title: Sun and shadows
sun.latitudeHint: Degrees: negative in the southern hemisphere (Santa Maria, RS: −30)
sun.hourHint: Solar time: 12 is when the sun is highest
sun.position: Sun {alt}° above the horizon, at {az}° from north.
sun.down: At this hour the sun is down: no shadows.
sun.hint: The shadows follow the north of the project. They fall on the ground only (not on other volumes or on the terrain) and stay near the site.
gif.title: Animation
gif.hint: One step after the other, all in the same frame, with number and title.
section.title: Section
section.tip: Cut the model by a plane parallel to this view: what is in front disappears, what is cut is filled
section.posTip: Where the section plane is, in metres behind the front of the site
shortcuts.polyEnd: End an outline drawn point by point
opening.title: Doors and windows
opening.addTip: Draws it in the middle of the wall that faces you; its place and size are in its properties
opening.hint: Drawn on the wall, without cutting the volume; they move and turn with it.
opening.explain: Drawn on a wall of {name}; it goes wherever that volume goes.
opening.orphan: The volume this was drawn on is no longer in this step.
opening.along: Along the wall, from its middle (negative: to the left)
opening.sill: Height of its sill above the base of the volume
area.jointsHint: Lines of a paved floor, this far apart (0: none).
arrow.heightEnd: Height where it ends (to climb or go down between levels)
label.notePlaceholder: A note under the text, smaller and lighter
label.markTip: A mark at the point: a warning, a refusal, a gain, a loss
sheet.blockText: Text. Start a line with + or − for a point for or against.
sheet.blocksHint: A column on the right of the sheet for what the drawings do not say: strategy, pros and cons, the next study. Up to eight blocks.
tool.hint.align: Click the face to align to, then the face of another shape: it moves until both lie in the same plane · Esc starts over
alignFaces.notParallel: These two faces are not parallel: pick a side for a side, or a top for a top.
alignFaces.locked: That shape is locked: unlock it to move it.
alignFaces.stacked: A volume standing on another takes its height from the one below: its top cannot be aligned.
alignFaces.nothing: These two faces are already in the same plane.
shortcuts.alignFaces: Align faces: the face to align to, then the face to bring to it
update.how.win-setup: The setup wizard of the new version is downloaded, checked and opened; LionAxon closes so that it can be replaced.
update.how.mac-dmg: The .dmg of the new version is downloaded to Downloads, checked and opened: drag LionAxon to Applications.
update.how.linux-appimage: The new AppImage is downloaded, checked and put in the place of this one; LionAxon opens again.
update.how.linux-deb: The .deb of the new version is downloaded to Downloads, checked and opened in the system's software installer.
update.how.linux-rpm: The .rpm of the new version is downloaded to Downloads, checked and opened in the system's software installer.
update.how.page: This copy was not put here by an installer: get the new version from the download page.
update.ready.wizard: The setup wizard is open. LionAxon closes now so that it can be replaced.
update.ready.dmg: The .dmg is open: close LionAxon and drag the new one to Applications.
update.ready.appimage: The new version is in place. LionAxon opens again now.
update.ready.package: The package is open in the system's software installer. Close LionAxon and install it.
update.failed.checksum: The file that came is not the one of the release, so it was discarded. Try again, or use the download page.
update.failed.network: The download did not finish. Check your connection and try again, or use the download page.
edit.lockedNote: Locked: it cannot be moved or resized in the drawing.
orbit.cube: View cube: click a face or a corner
orbit.navTip: Middle button in Rev mode (drag pans, Shift + drag orbits) or in Sketch mode (drag orbits, Shift + drag pans)
boot.skip: Cancel loading and start without a project
boot.slowTitle: LionAxon is taking long to open the last project
boot.slowDetail: You can keep waiting, or start the program without it. Nothing is lost: the diagrams of the last session are kept in Documents › LionAxon, to be opened when you want.
boot.asideDone: The last session took too long to open: its {n} diagram(s) were kept in {dir}. Open them with File › Open when you want.
site.joinedTip: Platforms and slopes that touch are drawn as one terrain, without the lines between them.
export.stepsDone: {n} files of the steps written in {dir}.
dialog.exportStepsTitle: Choose where to put the images of the steps
sheet.terrainGridTip: The terrain drawn as in the editor: see-through, with the grid on its surfaces (also in the exported images of the steps and the GIF).
label.wrapTip: The text breaks into lines at this width (0: one line per line typed). Pull the side of the blue box around the text to change it.
sheet.stepsHintFiles: The drawings of steps {list}, with no title or text: {n} files in a folder, in the same frame and at the same scale.
sheet.stepsHintSheet: A sheet with steps {list} only, in the layout, paper and scale chosen here.
export.stepsInvalid: Could not read “{part}”. Write steps from 1 to {n}: 7, 3-7 or 1, 4, 6-8 (empty: the current step; * for all).
label.wrapHandleTip: Drag to make the text box narrower or wider; the text breaks into lines on its own. Double-click: back to one line per line typed.
